# OfficeIMO OneNote fixtures

This folder recognizes the work of the [OfficeIMO project](https://github.com/EvotecIT/OfficeIMO) and the Apache Tika maintainers whose fixtures OfficeIMO records as sources. These are test inputs only; no OfficeIMO or Tika parser code is copied.

The five `testOneNote*.one` files are copied unchanged from Apache Tika commit `63e22d08ef249cc73a6d02da7bc199fc3623a607`, original path:

`tika-parsers/tika-parsers-standard/tika-parsers-standard-modules/tika-parser-microsoft-module/src/test/resources/test-documents/`

They are distributed under Apache-2.0. `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` are retained from OfficeIMO's fixture bundle. OfficeIMO pinned these unchanged files in commit `8e0c7f5d06c8ee7c2658c4e90eaa3c1bcd32d1f1`.

`makecab-lzx-notebook.onepkg` is a small synthetic notebook generated by OfficeIMO's `OneNoteNotebookWriter` and packaged with Windows `makecab`, as documented in OfficeIMO's `OfficeIMO.OneNote.Tests/Fixtures/SOURCE.md`. The OfficeIMO MIT license is included as `LICENSE-MIT-OfficeIMO.txt`. It is included to test detection of `.onepkg`; NoteCraft currently reports package files as noticed but not imported.

No modifications were made to the sample bytes. The test integration imports each `.one` fixture through NoteCraft in both HTML and CMGFM output modes and checks `.onepkg` detection.
